answer: Audit at random and make cheating expensive after the fact. Each epoch, a few answers are pulled for a deep second review by a fresh jury. If an account is caught recycling a template or a stolen essay, its locked earnings are slashed, and so are those of every peer who attested it. A sybil farm can look calm on the surface like a lotus pond, but one exposed relic of copied text can sink the whole cluster. The risk lands like a heavy plume on anyone vouching for fakes, so honest review becomes the safer bet.
